Name: Custom NPC Carnelian - English Translation
Author: VirtualShame
Description:
Hello! This is admittedly my first ever attempt at doing anything related to mods, modding, and translating, so please forgive my incompetence ;; I apologize beforehand if my translations are unsatisfactory and feel free to change and modify any strange wordings as you desire! ^^ [u]Below will include kolalu1's introduction to Carnelian.[/u] [b][i][u]Thank you kolalu1 for the amazing character!!! [/u][/i][/b]

[i][b]NOTES: It's HIGHLY recommended to play with characters that have pets! Also, some events occur independently from one another depending on friendship level. Because of this, please take your time to experience every event via friendship level. 

[/b][/i][u]Compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded?:[/u] In simple terms, kind of. [u]Carnelian will instead appear and live inside of Andy's farm[/u] rather than the forest below Marnie's house. I'm not completely sure how compatible it is with SDVE, nor is it explicitly detailed upon from the original untranslated mod. Additionally, [u]events such as 0❤ and 2[/u][u]❤ will be triggered by going to Andy's farm.[/u] Otherwise, I've yet to find any major errors that conflict between SDVE and Carnelian. 

[b]Compatibility with (INSERT HERE) Mod?:[/b] The compatibility of this mod with others should, in theory, be fine as long as said mod does not intrude upon event locations or drastically change the map, but I'm unsure entirely. Please feel free to mix and match to determine mod compatibilities ^^.

[b]The Demon Carnelian[/b]
A demon born and raised in the harsh environment of the demon world. Due to an intensive scuffle in his home realm, Carnelian barely escapes to the human realm and lands in Pelican Town, Stardew Valley. After his escape, the gate to the demon world has been closed, forcing the battle-scarred Carnelian to stay in this unknown yet beautiful town until he finds a way back. 

Perhaps if the new farmer is willing to befriend this strange demon, he might be tempted to become a permanent resident?

[b]Place of Residence: [/b]The forest beneath Marnie's farm, under a big tree.

[b]Favorites:[/b] Prismatic Shard, Ruby, Bone Flute, Void Essence, Apple, Poppyseed Muffin
[b]Likes: [/b]Bat Wing, Foods, Gemstones, Cherries, Flowers
[b]Dislikes: [/b]Animal Products (Processed+Unprocessed), Fertilizers, Farming Seeds
[b]Hates: [/b]Garbage, Fish Bait, Metal and Building Resources

[b]Events:
[/b]0❤: Go to the [u]forest near Marnie's house[/u] between [u]6:00 to 14:00.[/u]
2❤: Go to the [u]forest near Marnie's house[/u] on a [u]sunny day[/u] ([u][i][b]MUST HAVE EXISTING PET[/b][/i][/u]) between [u]6:00 to 16:00.[/u]
4❤: Go to the [u]beach[/u] on a [u]sunny day[/u] between[u] 8:00 to 23:00.
[/u]6❤: Go to [u]Secret Forest[/u] on a [u]sunny day[/u] between [u]8:00 to 18:00[/u].
8❤: Go to [u]Town[/u] on a [u]sunny day[/u] between [u]8:00 to 18:00[/u].
10❤: Go to [u]The Mountain[/u] on a[u] sunny day[/u] between [u]8:00 to 18:00[/u]. ([b][u][i]MUST HAVE EXPERIENCED 8[/i][/u][/b][b][u][i]❤ EVENT[/i][/u][/b]) 
14❤: Must have gone through [u]more than 29 game days[/u], [b][i][u]Letter[/u][/i][/b] will be received between [u]20:00 to 24:00[/u].
